title: Library services
titleCn: 图书馆服务咨询：找最近的图书馆和儿童活动

paragraphs.text: You should answer the questions as you listen because you will not hear the recording a second time.
Listen carefully and answer questions one to five.
Oh, good morning. My family and I have recently moved to the area, and we'd like to find where our nearest library is. We don't have a car.
Fine. So I'll just get the details on screen for you.
Okay. Your nearest one is the Minack Library.
It's very easy to find because it's beside a park.
Oh, I think I know that area. There's a sports center near there, isn't there?

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
don't know of one.

00:01:05,120

Oh, I'm probably mistaken. Anyway, it's probably a bit far for us to walk from home. Are there any buses?

00:01:12,740

Yes, it's well-served by public transport. There's a stop about five minutes walk away.

00:01:18,060

Oh, right. And when does the library open? We'll most often want to come at the weekend.

00:01:25,060

I'm afraid it's not open on Sunday.

00:01:27,660

Saturday?

00:01:28,840

Opens at 9:00, closes at 4:30. We shut at 5:00 on weekdays.

00:01:34,620

That's fine. Now, I've got two kids, fourteen and nine, and I wondered whether you have any special activities for them. In our last place, we had an art club.

00:01:45,740

Well, the library does run a drama club, but that would only be suitable for your younger child. It's open for five to thirteen year olds.

00:01:53,980

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text:
pity it's not open to both of them. Have you anything they could both go to?

00:01:59,660

Well, there's no reading club that would suit them both. Oh, but there's a singing club that's held every second Saturday afternoon for children of all ages up to sixteen.

00:02:09,660

Excellent.

00:02:13,920

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions six to ten on page two.

00:02:29,940

Now listen and answer questions six to ten.

00:02:53,880

Now, because we're new to the area, I'm also wanting to get involved in local activities.

00:02:59,760

Well, Minack does some sessions for adults as well. There's a Book of the Month club.

00:03:04,720

That's good.

00:03:05,680

And I know that about once every twelve months they have a session where you can meet artists, you know, from the local area.

00:03:13,520

How interesting. Well, that sounds like a full program. Now, while I'm on the phone, can I check what the facilities are? Can you take out CDs?

00:03:24,600

Not CDs, I'm afraid, but films, yes.

00:03:27,640

Right. I'll make a note of that.

00:03:29,800

Anything else you need to know? Oh, yes. We have ten computers, and we also stock several magazines, including business, healthcare, and hobbies.

00:03:39,800

Same as my last place.

00:03:41,560

And there is a new drop-off facility where you can post any item through the door if it's after hours. All you have to do is attach a note to it with the number on your card clearly written.

00:03:52,360

That sounds good.

00:03:53,680

And we do have a small shop on the premises where we sell postcards. We don't have many, but it's a popular service.

00:04:00,700

Oh, that's a good idea.

00:04:02,520

They're very popular. We also have an impressive range of maps of the surrounding area for sale.

00:04:08,460

Well, it sounds like you've got...

00:04:13,760

That is the end of section one. You now have half a minute to check your answers.
